FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 466
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Chris Blackshear
Analyst: JT Mathis Date: 05/12/2023
House Bill 466 as introduced would reduce business license tax receipts of municipalities that
levy taxes based on gross receipts by an undetermined amount dependent on the amount of
federal, state, and local excise taxes paid by businesses that would be deducted from gross
receipts for the calculation of municipal business license tax, as provided by this bill. This bill
will not otherwise affect state funding.
